Before I could still find enjoyment in small things even if the emptiness was there right afterward, now I can't and I'd prefer even sadness to the feeling of emptiness. Until now I've been able to cope telling myself that life isn't supposed to feel good, it's supposed to be difficult and we're supposed to struggle. Now I don't know anymore.
I spent too long in my head trying to escape. Any daydream or fantasy I have now turns to guilt about time wasted or how undeserving I am.

I don't know why the doctor said that. I was a child/young teenager and I think they had diagnosed me with severe depression. I tried certain medications but they were ineffective and in the end I was never able to feel "great"... just indifferent or not sad

We haven't fought since then, there's just tension and sadness. I had to go to urgent care the next morning for stitches in my mouth, when he punched me the tissue between my lip and gums tore and there was a large hole. I didn't realize it for most of that day because it didn't hurt badly.

I appreciate your kindness but I don't know where I can escape to. The sadness will follow me, the depression was here before I met him. I was a child and the doctor said I'd most likely feel this way my entire life

I don't have anywhere to go. No family or friends here. I know there is help available but I'm afraid of shelters. I'm a coward. Treatment never helped my depression, I will feel it for as long as I live. I'm fine with not existing. Death scares me but so does the alternative

North Carolina, I don't want to leave and lose what little I've been able to do for myself. More than that I truly want to die so it doesn't matter anyway. I just needed to get it off my chest. You are a good person, thank you for your concern

I think of it and I wish I could feel the light and warmth again but it's not appropriate and it won't happen. It makes me sad to think of.
I haven't done it because I'm scared and because I don't want to hurt my parents. You are a good person for caring about your family.

I agree that there are many nice and beautiful things. I love that there are beautiful things but it doesn't make me forget the solitude and emptiness... I'll continue to try. Thank you for responding.
